subject.title: fix(skill-workshop): validate apply body and show change summary before destructive writes

question: What signal should distinguish an intentional complete skill replacement from a plan-like or unrelated body before automatic destructive apply is allowed?
rationale: This defines the user-consent boundary for overwriting SKILL.md, and the current automatic approval behavior was a recent maintainer-owned product decision.

options.title: Use substantial similarity
options.body: Require meaningful bounded overlap for automatic apply and send low-similarity replacements to explicit approval.

options.title: Add explicit replacement intent
options.body: Require the proposal or apply request to declare a complete replacement before a low-similarity body can proceed.

options.title: Trust structural validity
options.body: Reject malformed bodies but preserve automatic approval for every valid SKILL.md regardless of similarity.

recommendation.title: Use substantial similarity
recommendation.body: Require meaningful bounded overlap for automatic apply and send low-similarity replacements to explicit approval.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the automatic lifecycle approval behavior whose consent boundary this PR changes.
